input.research_snippet: Search snippet only; the full page has not been read.
input.research_query_hint: Only this topic is sent to web search. Your source selections are kept.
input.research_send_hint: Relevant excerpts will be selected from your text and sent to your configured AI provider when you generate.
input.research_claims_note: Excerpts describe what each source says; they are not independently verified facts. Writing uses your included sources without additional searches.
input.research_invalid_url: Enter a complete http or https URL on each line.
input.research_url_limit: Choose up to 12 webpages for one research session.
input.research_urls_hint: One URL per line. These pages can be read with web search turned off.
input.research_quotes_hint: Keeps the wording of retrieved passages. Tone and reading level do not rewrite quotations.
input.research_privacy: Included source passages go to your configured AI provider. Web searches receive only the research topic.
input.research_sources_required: Select a document, add a webpage, or add source text in review.
